title: Bacon Cheeseburger Sliders — Thin Patties

title: Butter Chicken — Fresh Garlic & Ginger

standardization.description: 1.75 lb chicken; same butter chicken base as the spice-kit version, with fresh garlic and fresh ginger in both marinade and sauce

nutrition.calculation: pending_ingredient_brand_and_weight_review

steps.instruction: Whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, marinade spices, minced fresh garlic, and finely grated fresh ginger.
Coat the chicken in the marinade, refrigerate, and marinate (overnight is an established option).
Roast marinated chicken at 450°F until cooked through and 165°F internally; thicker thighs may take longer than the earlier 18–20 minute guideline.
Rest briefly, cut chicken into pieces, and reserve the pan juices.
Melt the first portion of butter over medium heat and soften the diced onion.

Add tomato paste and the remaining dry sauce spices (plus sugar and salt). Stir and cook briefly until fragrant, without scorching.
Add canned tomatoes and cream; simmer to combine.
Add chicken and reserved juices to the sauce; simmer together for approximately 7–8 minutes.
Stir in the remaining butter and adjust seasoning before serving.
